messages:
Sasha K: Quick favor — nightly lm_infer bench flagged a small latency hump on PR #3214. Can someone run a quick nsys + torch.profiler smoke trace so we can check KV-cache behavior and any kernel stalls?

Priya R: I can take this. Which branch/commit and exact command do you want me to run?

Sasha K: thx! Use the PR branch (https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3214) at head. Minimal repro: warmup 2 iters then capture 10 iters. Example local command:
```
NSYS_LOGFILE=/tmp/nsys.qdrep 
nsys profile -o /tmp/nsys_trace --trace=cuda,cublas,cudnn,osrt --stats=true -- python bench/lm_inference.py --model redwood/llama-13b --batch_size 1 --seq_len 512 --iters 12 --warmup 2
```
Also include a small torch.profiler capture around the loop, e.g.:
```python
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA], record_shapes=True) as prof:
    run_iteration()
# save prof.key_averages().table(sort_by="self_cuda_time_total")
```
Capture env: `git rev-parse --short HEAD`, CUDA, driver, and `nvcc --version`.

Marco L: If you get a `.qdrep` please export the sqlite with `nsys export -f sqlite -i /tmp/nsys_trace.qdrep -o /tmp/nsys_trace.sqlite` so I can run flamegraphs quickly. Also grab `nsys stats` summary.

Jenna T: I don't have S3 write — what's the upload path?

Sasha K: s3 path: `s3://redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/3214/<your-username>/` please compress with `tar -czf pr3214-nsys-<user>.tgz /tmp/nsys_trace.* prof.json env.txt` before upload. If you can't write, DM me or @jenna and I'll stage it.

Priya R: Running now on one RTX A5000 in `dev-gpu-3`. Will warmup 2 iters then collect 10, export sqlite, scrub env, then upload. ETA ~8m.

perf-bot: Profiling checklist reminder: include commit hash, full cmdline, nsys qdrep + exported sqlite, torch.profiler output, host `dmesg` and `nvidia-smi` snapshot, and a short note describing the regression. Attach logs to s3 or paste a link. :white_check_mark:

Marco L: One more thing — please set `TORCH_USE_RTLD_GLOBAL=1` if you see missing kernel symbols during export, and include `--capture-startup` if the regression appears on first token.

Priya R: Got it. Using `TORCH_USE_RTLD_GLOBAL=1` and `--capture-startup`. Uploading to s3 now, will paste link when done.

Sasha K: awesome, thanks @Priya R. @Marco L @Jenna T please take a look once uploaded. If anything sensitive in the trace ping me before share.

Priya R: Uploaded: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-profiling/eng-runtime/3214/priya/pr3214-nsys-priya.tgz — scrubbed with `tools/trace-scrub.py` and redacted hosts.

Marco L: grabbing now, starting quick flamegraph pass.

Jenna T: I can confirm upload access now, thanks.

Sasha K: will follow up with perf observations in the PR. Thanks team!
